title: When Valid Decisions Are Not Enough: Evaluating Structural Constraints in Knowledge-Guided Generative Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.20111v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Knowledge-guided generative systems use explicit domain constraints to improve decision consistency and alignment with human-created solutions. However, locally valid decisions do not necessarily preserve contextual relationships in human decision-making. This paper examines when structural constraints improve or degrade agreement with human reference solutions.   We introduce HARMONIX, an experimental framework using automated musical harmonization as a controlled testbed for knowledge-guided decision-making. Four configurations share the same Viterbi-based optimization mechanism: a baseline, repetition constraints, functional constraints, and their combination. Experiments cover 19,745 records and 143,634 motif pairs across training and validation partitions. translated_title: 当有效决策还不够时：评估知识引导生成系统中的结构约束
translated_abstract: 知识引导生成系统利用显式的领域约束来提升决策一致性以及与人类创建解决方案的对齐程度。然而，局部有效的决策并不一定能保留人类决策中的上下文关系。本文研究了结构约束在何时会改善或降低与人类参考解决方案的一致性。我们提出了HARMONIX，一个以自动音乐和声编配作为受控测试平台的实验框架，用于知识引导决策研究。四种配置共享相同的基于Viterbi的优化机制：基线、重复约束、功能约束以及二者的组合。实验涵盖训练与验证分区中的19,745条记录和143,634个动机对。结果表明，组合约束在稳定结构语境中将参考根音程一致性提高了约五个百分点，但在其他情境中却降低了近九个百分点。
tldr: 论文提出HARMONIX自动音乐和声实验框架，发现组合结构约束在稳定结构语境中能将与人类参考方案的一致性提升约5个百分点，但在其他情境中反而降低近9个百分点，揭示了局部有效决策未必符合人类决策的上下文关系。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces HARMONIX, an automated musical harmonization testbed, showing that combined structural constraints improve agreement with human reference solutions by ~5 percentage points in stable contexts but degrade it by nearly 9 points elsewhere, revealing that locally valid decisions do not guarantee human-like contextual relationships.
